annotations.title: Candle lighting and havdalah in an Israeli city

description: Candle lighting and havdalah for the Shabbat around a date (and the day itself when it is a yom tov), plus sunrise and sunset, for 24 Israeli cities. Sea-level sunset (Jerusalem: sunset seen from 800 m); candles by local custom (Jerusalem 40 min, Tel Aviv 22, Haifa 30, most cities 20), matching the Ministry of Religious Services table; havdalah at 8.5 degrees. Israel time, rounded to the minute.
name: shabbat_times
